name: @local/dsh-gowin
description: DSH 插件：高云 Gowin 1.9 FPGA 工具链全流程掌握 —— 环境探针、工程/约束读写校验、命令行编译（gw_sh）、烧录（programmer_cli）、报告解析、GAO 在线逻辑分析链路。纯 JS 零依赖。

meta.title: 高云 Gowin FPGA 工具链 (Gowin)
meta.description: Registers read-only + build/flash tools for the Gowin 1.9 toolchain: environment probe, .gprj/.cst project and constraint auditing against real board pinouts, gw_sh batch build, pnr report/resource/timing parsing, programmer_cli flash and JTAG scan, and the GAO on-line logic analyzer capture chain. Ships the full Gowin agent playbook as bundled skills and references.
